_comment: Scripted demo scores. Overall formula: round(n_high*18 + n_medium*3 + n_low//3). 3H/5M/12L → 73. Post-fix (0H/5M/12L) → 19 (~18%).

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Near-exact match to AMD_001: drug-naïve inclusion criterion causing >70% screen failure in T2DM trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: T2DM patients are almost universally initiated on metformin at diagnosis; truly drug-naïve adults are rare in the target age range.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard screening procedure; no additional testing required beyond the routine HbA1c and medication history.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Eliminates the vast majority of the T2DM population who have received at least one OAD; most Phase III sites report <5% of screened T2DM patients are genuinely drug-naïve.

endpoint_instrument_validation.reasoning: No PRO or QoL instrument referenced in this clause.

visit_burden.reasoning: Not a visit-schedule clause; no impact on visit frequency or patient burden.

top_pattern_match.description: Inclusion too restrictive — drug-naïve requirement causing >70% screen failure

blk_4_4.summary: The drug-naïve requirement will likely cause excessive screen failures; T2DM patients are almost universally on at least one OAD at diagnosis.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Strong match to AMD_002: BMI < 35 kg/m² threshold excludes the majority of obese T2DM patients, particularly in US and Brazil.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: T2DM is strongly associated with obesity; WHO obesity class II (BMI 35-39.9) and class III (≥40) are overrepresented in the target population.

operational_complexity.reasoning: BMI is a routine screening measurement; no operational complexity.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: BMI < 35 excludes approximately 45% of screened T2DM patients in US and Brazilian sites where obesity prevalence is highest, making global enrollment targets unachievable.

top_pattern_match.description: BMI threshold too restrictive — excludes majority of obese T2DM population

blk_4_3.summary: BMI < 35 kg/m² eliminates approximately 45% of the intended T2DM population in high-enrollment US and Brazil sites.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Strong match to AMD_031: weekly clinic visits throughout a 24-week treatment period — one of the most common causes of dropout in insulin trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Weekly visits are atypical for a 24-week maintenance insulin titration study; standard practice is biweekly after initial stabilization.

operational_complexity.reasoning: 24 mandatory clinic visits per patient requires substantial site staffing and patient logistics; sites in Japan and Brazil flagged access constraints for working patients.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion, but functionally restricts participation to patients with reliable transport and flexible schedules.

visit_burden.reasoning: 24 weekly clinic visits is 3-4× the typical burden for a Phase III insulin trial; comparable trials use biweekly visits after Week 4-8.

top_pattern_match.description: Visit schedule too burdensome — weekly clinic visits for 24 weeks cause excessive dropout

blk_6_2.summary: Weekly clinic visits for 24 consecutive weeks will drive dropout; comparable T2DM trials use biweekly visits after initial titration stabilization.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Partial match to AMD_011: hepatic exclusion at 3×ULN is appropriate for hepatotoxic drugs but may be misaligned with NASH/NAFLD comorbidity prevalence in T2DM.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: NASH/NAFLD co-occurrence in T2DM is 55-75%; the 3×ULN threshold may exclude a clinically meaningful subgroup for whom the drug could be beneficial.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard liver function testing; no additional operational complexity.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: The Child-Pugh C or ALT/AST >3×ULN exclusion is more permissive than some prior drafts but still excludes T2DM patients with common metabolic liver disease.

top_pattern_match.description: Hepatic exclusion threshold may be too conservative for NASH/NAFLD-prevalent T2DM population

blk_5_6.summary: Hepatic exclusion at 3×ULN may exclude a significant T2DM/NASH overlap population; consider raising to 5×ULN if the compound has no hepatotoxicity signal.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Direct match to AMD_032: ±3 calendar day visit window is the most restrictive in current guidelines and routinely drives protocol deviations in global trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Insulin titration studies typically allow ±5-7 day windows after the first 4 weeks; ±3 days is appropriate only for PK-intensive periods.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Strict ±3-day window requires coordinated scheduling across 60+ sites in 6 countries with different public holiday calendars and healthcare access patterns.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

visit_burden.reasoning: Narrow ±3-day window substantially increases patient burden; real-world scheduling in JP and BR often requires 5-7 day flexibility.

top_pattern_match.description: Visit window ±3 days too narrow — common source of protocol deviations in multinational trials

blk_6_3.summary: A ±3-day visit window in a 60-site, 6-country trial is a common source of protocol deviations; ±5-7 days is the multinational standard after Week 8.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Partial match to AMD_012: CV event exclusion within 6 months is the regulatory default but may be over-conservative for a basal insulin with no cardiac liability.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: T2DM patients with recent CV events represent the highest-risk, highest-need subgroup; excluding them limits generalizability.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard medical history review; no additional burden.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: 6-month MACE exclusion eliminates ~12% of T2DM patients at Phase III-eligible sites; FDA guidance allows 3-month exclusion for insulin products with no cardiac signal.

top_pattern_match.description: CV event exclusion window may be overly conservative for a metabolic compound

blk_5_3.summary: The 6-month MACE exclusion window exceeds FDA guidance for metabolic compounds; consider reducing to 3 months to improve enrollment feasibility.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Strong match to AMD_021: QoL_12 is not validated in Chinese (zh) or Brazilian Portuguese (pt), yet the protocol includes CN and BR as target countries.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: HbA1c, CGM, and SMBG endpoints are appropriate for T2DM; QoL_12 is a reasonable exploratory endpoint but the language gap is the risk.

operational_complexity.reasoning: CGM sub-study adds logistical complexity at selected sites; QoL_12 translation gap will require either a validation study or instrument substitution.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

endpoint_instrument_validation.reasoning: QoL_12 is validated in en, es, fr, de, ja — but NOT in zh or pt. The protocol targets CN (requires zh) and BR (requires pt). ICH E9(R1) mandates validated translations for PRO instruments in all target country languages.

visit_burden.reasoning: QoL_12 is administered at baseline and Week 24 only; minimal additional burden.

top_pattern_match.description: QoL_12 not validated in Chinese or Brazilian Portuguese — ICH E9(R1) compliance gap

blk_3_4.summary: QoL_12 lacks validated translations for Chinese (CN site) and Brazilian Portuguese (BR site); use EQ-5D-5L or validate QoL_12 in zh and pt before study start.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Partial match to AMD_014: corticosteroid exclusion threshold of >10 mg/day prednisone equivalent for >7 days is clinically defensible but may require amendment if patients use short burst courses.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Short-course corticosteroids for comorbidities (e.g., asthma, gout flares) are common in T2DM patients; the 7-day window may inadvertently exclude patients on legitimate short-burst regimens.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard medication history; no additional complexity.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Corticosteroid use for >7 consecutive days at >10 mg/day prednisone equivalent within 3 months is not uncommon in T2DM patients managing comorbid inflammatory conditions.

top_pattern_match.description: Corticosteroid exclusion threshold may produce unexpected screen failures in comorbid population

blk_5_5.summary: Corticosteroid exclusion is clinically appropriate but the 7-day/10 mg threshold may need clarification for intermittent burst regimens common in comorbid T2DM.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Weak match to historical patterns; age 18-65 is standard for Phase III T2DM trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Age range appropriate for the T2DM target population; some sites flagged exclusion of elderly (>65) but this is a known trial design choice.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard age verification at screening.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Age 18-65 is standard; minor risk of excluding elderly T2DM patients with the highest unmet need.

blk_4_1.summary: Standard age eligibility for a Phase III T2DM trial; low amendment risk.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Weak match; HbA1c 7.5-10% is the standard glycemic eligibility window for Phase III insulin trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: HbA1c window aligns with FDA guidance for T2DM inadequate control studies.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard central laboratory HbA1c testing.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Window may exclude very high (>10%) or borderline (7-7.5%) patients but is aligned with regulatory precedent.

blk_4_2.summary: Standard HbA1c eligibility window consistent with FDA guidance and Phase III precedent; low amendment risk.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: No strong pattern match; Type 1 DM exclusion is standard for insulin T2DM trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Anti-GAD65/IA-2 antibody testing adds specificity; appropriate for distinguishing LADA from T2DM.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Antibody testing requires central laboratory and adds cost; however, this is standard for insulin-naïve T2DM trials.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Correct exclusion for the study population.

blk_5_1.summary: Standard Type 1 DM and LADA exclusion for an insulin T2DM trial; no amendment risk anticipated.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Weak match; eGFR <30 severe renal impairment exclusion is the FDA-standard threshold for insulin trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Appropriate exclusion; insulin dosing in severe CKD carries hypoglycemia risk warranting exclusion.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard creatinine/eGFR assessment at screening.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Excludes only the most severe renal impairment; appropriate.

blk_5_2.summary: Standard renal safety exclusion; eGFR <30 threshold aligns with FDA labeling precedent for basal insulin.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: No match; pregnancy/breastfeeding exclusion is universally required.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Appropriate standard exclusion with required contraception documentation.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Routine urine/serum pregnancy test and contraception counseling at screening.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Standard exclusion.

blk_5_4.summary: Standard pregnancy/breastfeeding exclusion; no amendment risk.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: No significant pattern match; screening visit with standard procedures.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Comprehensive screening battery appropriate for T2DM insulin trial.

operational_complexity.reasoning: CGM sub-study device fitting adds minor site complexity; otherwise standard.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

endpoint_instrument_validation.reasoning: No PRO instrument administered at screening.

visit_burden.reasoning: Standard screening visit; 14-day window is appropriate.

blk_6_1.summary: Standard screening visit structure; no amendment risk anticipated.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Weak match; standard secondary objectives for a T2DM insulin trial.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: HbA1c <7.0% target, nocturnal hypoglycemia, FPG, and ITSQ are standard for the indication.

operational_complexity.reasoning: ITSQ requires validated translations; ITSQ is not validated in zh or pt, similar to QoL_12. However, it is an exploratory endpoint and the risk is lower.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

endpoint_instrument_validation.reasoning: ITSQ validation status in zh/pt should be confirmed; however, ITSQ is a secondary endpoint and the risk is lower than a primary PRO.

blk_3_3.summary: Standard secondary objectives; ITSQ validation should be confirmed for CN and BR sites but risk is low at the secondary level.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Weak match; structured titration algorithm is standard for basal insulin trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Titration from 10 units with 2-unit increments every 3 days is consistent with glargine prescribing information.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Double-dummy blinding with identical device appearance adds minor complexity; otherwise standard.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

visit_burden.reasoning: Weekly titration visits are related to blk_6_2; this clause describes the algorithm, not the schedule.

blk_7_2.summary: Standard basal insulin titration algorithm; no amendment risk anticipated.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: No significant pattern match; sample size calculation is standard.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Sample size powered at 90% for −0.30% HbA1c difference is aligned with Phase II data.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard statistical planning.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

blk_8_1.summary: Sample size and power calculations are appropriate; no amendment risk.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: No significant match; hierarchical testing for key secondary endpoints is standard.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: Hierarchical testing order is clinically logical for a T2DM insulin trial.

operational_complexity.reasoning: Standard statistical analysis.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

blk_8_3.summary: Standard hierarchical testing procedure; no amendment risk.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Weak match; AE/SAE definitions and hypoglycemia classification are standard for T2DM trials.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: ADA/EASD 2021 hypoglycemia grading (Level 1/2/3) is current best practice.

operational_complexity.reasoning: MedDRA coding and CTCAE grading require trained staff at all sites.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

blk_9_1.summary: Standard AE/SAE definitions using current ADA classification; no amendment risk.

pattern_match_strength.reasoning: Weak match; DSMB charter with pre-specified stopping rules is regulatory standard.

therapeutic_area_fit.reasoning: DSMB reviews at 30/60/90% enrollment are appropriate for a Phase III hypoglycemia-risk trial.

operational_complexity.reasoning: DSMB requires independent statistical programming and unblinded data packages.

inclusion_restrictiveness.reasoning: Not an eligibility criterion.

blk_9_3.summary: Appropriate DSMB charter and review frequency for a Phase III insulin trial; no amendment risk.
